translations.web: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
translations.bsb: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
translations.kjv: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe
translations.asv: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
